items.title: Conrad "Connie" Jones Interview, 1981-07-23, 08-03
items.q: Once again, Neil, like you said, if I had only known then, but some way or another, uh, they've all gotten away from us.

ctx.x: What sort of songs would you sing? I'll play, I'll bowl.

Uh, it would be, uh, mostly, I can remember we did a lot of Irving, we had a lot of Irving Berlin sheet music. And, uh, things from Broadway shows. Mm-hmm. Uh, I can, I remember we had the sheet music for Cabin in the Sky. If I'm not mistaken, it had a picture of, uh, Ethel Waters on the front. This is a long time ago. Uh, and we had Irving Berlin's Remember. And we had Always. Uh-hmm. On sheet music. Oh, gee, I, we had stacks and stacks of it. Once again, Neil, like you said, if I had only known then, but some…
You can, you can find a lot of those things.
